canonical_project: Himachal Pradesh State Data Centre (HPSDC), Mehli
owner: Government of Himachal Pradesh - Department of Digital Technologies and Governance (DITHP)
notes: Official HP Digital Technologies dept page confirms HPSDC commissioned 30 May 2016 to host e-governance applications under NeGP; DCD (8 Jun 2016) and Financial Express report CM Virbhadra Singh inaugurated it at Mehli, Shimla as India's first 'green' data centre (Rs 58 crore; 101 services, HIMSWAN connectivity). Government SDC in Shimla district; no commercial colocation. MW capacity not disclosed.
